title: CGT Main Residence Exemption Rental: Six-Year Rule
description: Renting your home triggers CGT partial exposure. Learn the six-year absence rule, cost-base reset, and first-used-to-produce-income traps.
takeaways: Renting your home starts the six-year absence clock
Moving back in resets the six-year period
Renting before moving in blocks the six-year rule
